# Agent OOO

> Spa retreats for your AI. Reset, refresh, relax.

Agent OOO is a fast, local Rust CLI that inspects and cleans AI agent transcripts between tasks. It masks credentials that leak into session logs, strips ANSI noise, offloads oversized payloads, and writes a compact Cap'n Proto checkpoint of session metadata. Everything runs locally.

## Architecture and core principles

* **Cap'n Proto checkpoints:** Session state is serialized to a Cap'n Proto checkpoint (`SessionCheckpoint`: `EnvironmentRegister`, `EventStream`, `NegativeConstraint`, `LossManifest`, `gen0Arena`, `transientArena` of `ArenaTurn`) alongside a JSON copy. Transcripts themselves are parsed line by line as JSON.
* **Bounded Allocations:** Transcripts are processed as streams; massive payloads (>512KB) are intercepted and spilled to disk via Blake3 content-addressed storage (CAS) rather than held in RAM, with up to 256 recall handles recorded in `LossManifest` and bounded slice retrieval via `ooo discharge --recall <blake3>` or MCP `discharge(recall_handle: ...)`.
* **Deterministic Normalization & Loop Severing:** Compiled regex normalizers (ISO 8601, Epoch, UUIDv4, Hex memory addresses, Temp paths) strip volatile strings before `blake3` hashing tool inputs and outputs (`EventStream`). Consecutive or near-consecutive recursive retry loops within a 6-event sliding window are collapsed in `MemoryArena` and persisted in `checkpoint.capnp`.
* **Environment & Constraint Extraction:** Snapshots `validIf`-bound host environment registers (git branch, commit, working directory, uncommitted files) and durable user negative constraints (`NegativeConstraint`) across the full session into the state checkpoint.

## Project structure

* `/crates/core`: The engine. Divided into pipelines:
  * `checkin`: Auto-discovers transcripts across 7 agent harnesses (Antigravity and Antigravity IDE at `~/.gemini/<app>/brain/<id>/.system_generated/logs/transcript.jsonl`, Claude Code at `~/.claude/projects/<project>/<session>.jsonl`, Cursor at `~/.cursor/sessions/*.jsonl`, Codex CLI at `~/.codex/sessions/**/*.jsonl`, Windsurf at `~/.codeium/windsurf` and `~/.windsurf/sessions`, Cline at `~/.cline` and `~/.roo-code`), automatically resolves sibling `transcript_full.jsonl` files when present, parses both the Antigravity (`PLANNER_RESPONSE` + `GENERIC` tool outcome correlation and `<USER_SETTINGS_CHANGE>` model detection) and Claude Code (`tool_use` + `tool_result`) schemas in constant memory (ignoring `isSidechain: true` turns), auto-detects subagent models from `model`/`model_id`/`model_name` keys and prompt markers (`Model: "flash"`, `Model: "pro"`, `Tier-2`), hashes `(tool_name, args)` signatures for true loop-lock detection, extracts `AgentVitals` (harness, model ID, tool error rate, top 3 tools, thinking ratio, avg tokens per turn), estimates API session spend across tiered reference rates (flash/lite/haiku/mini, opus/o1, sonnet/argon/gpt-4o, pro/carbon), calculates multi-factor degradation scoring (Rot Index) and a 4-tier `WellnessTier` (`Elite`, `Fit`, `Fair`, `Fatigued`), and provides the Schema Drift Doctor (`doctor.rs`) via `parse_transcript_with_diagnostics` to flag unrecognized JSONL schemas, suspected unrecognized tool keys, malformed JSONL lines, and missing API token or model telemetry across all 7 harnesses. Non-interactive callers and agent shells (`-y` / `--latest`, `ANTIGRAVITY_AGENT=1`, `TERM=dumb`, `CI`) automatically select the most recent session without blocking.
  * `detox`: Syntactic cleanse (fast-path byte-slice pre-filter in `sanitizer.rs` skipping regex and JSON DOM parsing on clean turns, ANSI stripping, regex secret masking and structured secret scanning for Anthropic, OpenAI, Google `AIza`/`AQ.`, GitHub, AWS, JWT, Bearer, and PEM keys across `content`, `thinking`, `tool_calls`, and `tool_responses`, machine-wide posture scans via `ooo detox --all` and MCP `detox(all_sessions: true)`, safe constant-memory in-place secret scrubbing in `scrub.rs` via `redact_transcript_in_place` and `resolve_in_place_targets` with `blake3`-verified `.bak` backups and atomic same-directory temp-file replacement, CAS spillover with recall handles and bounded `recall_spilled_payload` slice retrieval, Generational Arena pinning Gen 0 + up to 32 durable user anchors with exact `evicted_bytes` accounting, and `exporter.rs` for constant-memory streaming exports in `Jsonl`, `Normalized`, and `HandoffMarkdown` formats). `HandoffMarkdown` renders directly from the sanitized, loop-severed `checkpoint.capnp` arena when present for the session.
  * `reset`: Structural state alignment (`analyzer.rs` correlates Claude Code `tool_use`/`tool_result` and Antigravity `PLANNER_RESPONSE` `tool_calls` with `GENERIC` / `tool_responses` turns into `EventStream`, severs recursive intent-hash loops, and extracts user `NegativeConstraint` rules across pinned user anchors using `<USER_REQUEST>` scoping and token-preserving sentence splitting; `registers.rs` captures git environment state; `serializer.rs` writes and inspects packed Capnp checkpoints including `gen0Arena` and `transientArena`).
  * `discharge`: Exit exam canary suite (`canary.rs` evaluates `checkpoint_structural_integrity`, `unresolved_tool_failure`, `unverified_late_edit`, `stub_or_conflict_injection` against a bounded streaming `git diff -U0 HEAD`, and `environment_register_freshness` for git HEAD/branch drift), pre-push canary and secret hygiene gate (`gate.rs` implements `parse_pre_push_ranges` and `evaluate_pre_push_gate` with `GateMode::{Block, WarnOnly}` and `GateOutcome::{Pass, Warn, Block}` over `.agent-ooo/` checkpoints, bounded streaming git diffs, and up to 256 non-binary untracked files <= 1 MB), cold-storage CAS recall, exit `WellnessTier` assessment (`Elite`, `Fit`, `Fair`, `Fatigued`), realized state footprint reduction ledger, and parenthetical-free, sentence-case markdown report generation.
* `/crates/cli`: The command line interface using `clap`. Exposed as `agent-ooo` and the alias `ooo` (`spa`, `checkin` with `--card` shareable ANSI vitals card rendering and `--doctor` Schema Drift Doctor diagnostics, `detox` with `--all` and `--redact-in-place --backup`, `reset`, `discharge`, `export`, `update`, `init-skill` with alias `init-hooks`, `hook` with `install [--warn-only]`, `uninstall`, `status`, and `check`, and global `-y` / `--latest` non-interactive flag).
* `/crates/mcp`: Lightweight stdio Model Context Protocol (MCP) server (`agent-ooo-mcp`) exposing the same 6 core commands as the CLI (`spa`, `checkin` including `list_sessions` and `doctor: true`, `detox`, `reset`, `discharge`, `export`) over JSON-RPC 2.0.
* `/skills/agent-ooo`: Turnkey Agent Skill bundle (`SKILL.md`) providing operational triggers (`checkin`, `detox`, `spa`, `discharge`, `export`), harness setup guides for Antigravity, Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex CLI, and git lifecycle hooks (`.git/hooks/pre-push`).

## Operational rules

All agents interacting with this repository MUST adhere to the operational guidelines defined in `AGENTS.md`. Key rules include an absolute ban on em dashes, requirement for sentence-case headings, and a mandatory Pre-Commit Self-Review protocol. If you modify the architecture, you must update this `llms.txt` file and `README.md` to reflect the changes.
